description:
JANUS — Astronaut Health Intelligence

I am developing Project Janus, a concept focused on astronaut health monitoring during space missions. My proposed app will explore health-data visualization, trend monitoring, and hand-function tracking inspired by EVA glove research.
summary: JANUS is an astronaut wellness dashboard designed to explore how technology can support crew health during space missions. Our prototype allows users to enter heart-rate and sleep-duration readings and generate a simple wellness report. Beyond these basic indicators, JANUS aims to explore hand-function monitoring, inspired by the challenges astronauts face while performing delicate tasks in EVA gloves. Our goal is to bring more attention to the human side of space exploration through accessible technology.
details: JANUS: Astronaut Wellness Dashboard Space exploration is not just about rockets, planets and new discoveries. It is also about the people who travel into space and the challenges they face while living and working there. This is what inspired me to create JANUS. JANUS is a simple astronaut wellness dashboard that explores how technology can help keep track of astronauts' well-being during space missions. In the current version, users can enter an astronaut's heart rate and sleep duration. The dashboard then generates a basic report and shows whether the sleep duration meets its demo target. While developing this idea, I also became interested in the challenges astronauts face while wearing EVA gloves. These gloves can make delicate hand movements and everyday tasks more difficult. This inspired me to explore hand-function monitoring as a possible future feature of JANUS. It is an idea I hope to develop further, rather than a feature already available in the current app. I built JANUS using Python and Streamlit. Python helped me create the logic, while Streamlit helped me turn it into an interactive dashboard. I used fictional readings to demonstrate how the prototype works. What makes JANUS special to me is its focus on the human side of space exploration. I wanted to look beyond spacecraft and technology and think about the health, comfort and everyday challenges of astronauts. This is an early prototype, and there is still a lot I would love to improve. My goal is to develop JANUS further into a tool that explores different aspects of astronaut wellness. Because space exploration isn't only about how far humans can go. It's also about how well we look after the humans who get there.
